invariant: PlantUML Entity and Link constructors consume one shared CucaDiagram.cpt1 sequence at the instant each object is created. Commands may interleave object kinds on the same source line. In particular, CommandCreateClass creates the child, then manageExtends creates one missing parent and its Link before moving to the next missing parent and Link. The resulting public SVEK IDs reflect this constructor event order, not a later sort by source line or object category.
causal_divergence: Rust stores entities, relationships, packages, notes, and association classes in separate vectors and later reconstructs the shared counter using CucaUidEvent.sort_key. Its same-line category ordering forces every newly inferred supertype entity ahead of every declaration relationship. For `class Child extends Base implements Port`, Java allocates child, Base, first link, Port, second link; Rust allocates child, Base, Port, first link, second link. No source-line/category sort can recover arbitrary cross-kind constructor interleaving.
planned_change: Record a typed UID creation event whenever the parser first materializes a package or entity or constructs a note, relationship, or association class. Store stable entity/package identities and vector indices for the other event types on ClassDiagram. Have no-oracle SVEK allocation replay that event stream, filtering only objects absent from the rendered model, while retaining the current deterministic reconstruction as a compatibility fallback for manually constructed diagrams and older serialized models. Add perturbations for declaration supertypes, missing relationship endpoints, notes before and after links, phantom groups, aliases, and reordered declarations.
perturbation_axes: extends plus implements with both targets missing
missing supertype crossed with preexisting supertype

attached and floating notes before and after links
